([[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]]) | college = [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] (2018–2021) | highlights = * Third-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] (2021) }} '''RaiQuan Gray''' (born July 7, 1999) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State Seminoles]]. ==Early life and high school career== Gray grew up playing [[American football|football]] and started playing basketball at age nine.{{cite web |last1=Walsh |first1=Chuck |title=Growth spurt helps Gray’s basketball quest |url=http://capitaloutlook.com/site/growth-spurt-helps-grays-basketball-quest/ |website=Capital Outlook |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=April 21, 2020}} He attended [[Dillard High School]] in [[Fort Lauderdale, Florida]]. Gray played the [[point guard]] position despite being 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m) and 260 lbs (118 kg). As a junior, he led Dillard to the Class 6A state title.{{cite web |last1=Lyon |first1=Fabian |title=Dillard’s dynamic duo is back to defend title |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/high-school/article116589563.html |website=[[Miami Herald]] |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=November 22, 2016}} In his senior season, Gray won the Class 7A state title.{{cite web |last1=Brown |first1=A. Richard |title=Class 7A Final: Dillard rolls over Edgewater |url=https://www.theledger.com/sports/20170304/class-7a-final-dillard-rolls-over-edgewater |website=[[The Ledger]] |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=March 4, 2017}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] over offers from [[Baylor Bears basketball|Baylor]] and [[Memphis Tigers men's basketball|Memphis]].{{cite web |last1=Lammer |first1=Pat |title=Dillard star RaiQuan Gray pledges Florida State |url=https://www.sun-sentinel.com/sports/highschool/fl-recruiting-commitment-announcements-0809-20160808-story.html |website=[[Sun-Sentinel]] |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=August 8, 2016}} ==College career== Gray [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirted]] his first year at Florida State. As a freshman, he averaged 3.9 points in 12.3 minutes per game.{{cite web |last1=Weiler |first1=Curt |title=New-look RaiQuan Gray reaping rewards of offseason work for FSU basketball |url=https://www.news-press.com/story/sports/college/fsu/mensbasketball/2021/01/26/florida-state-fsu-mens-basketball-raiquan-gray-body-transformation-seminoles-nba-leonard-hamilton/6695232002/ |website=[[The News-Press]] |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=January 26, 2021}} Gray averaged six points and 3.8 rebounds per game as a sophomore.{{cite web |last1=Brown |first1=Anthony |title=Florida State Basketball: Raiquan Gray a key piece for Seminoles in 2020-21 |url=https://bustingbrackets.com/2020/09/22/florida-state-basketball-raiquan-gray-key-piece-seminoles-2020-21/ |website=Busting Brackets |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=September 22, 2020}} He improved his conditioning in the offseason. On February 13, 2021, he recorded a career-high 24 points and 12 rebounds in a 92–85 win over [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web |last1=Ferrante |first1=Bob |title=RaiQuan Gray lifts No. 17 FSU to win over Wake Forest in OT |url=https://www.orlandosentinel.com/sports/florida-state-seminoles/os-sp-fsu-basketball-0214-20210213-iurehuq32naypm2jpkljlghhoi-story.html |website=[[Orlando Sentinel]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=March 3, 2021 |date=February 13, 2021}} As a junior, Gray averaged 11.9 points, 6.4 rebounds and 2.2 assists per game, earning Third Team All-[[Atlantic Coast Conference]] honors. On April 2, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]].{{cite web |last1=Schoffel |first1=Ira |title=Seminoles star forward RaiQuan Gray declares for NBA Draft |url=https://floridastate.rivals.com/news/seminoles-star-forward-raiquan-gray-declares-for-nba-draft |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=July 28, 2021 |date=April 2, 2021}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2017–18 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] | style="text-align:center;" colspan="11"|
